incident-bot: SEV2 - High error rate observed for Dedicated EU cluster affecting routing to customer Zenobu. Alert triggered at 2024-10-03T14:20:39Z. Paging on-call.

maria_oncall: I'm on it, joining. seeing 502 spikes on dedicated-eu-gpupool.

aj_eng: I can check the model router logs and pathing, pulling logs now.

sam_sre: Checking autoscaler and node health, will confirm whether it's capacity or network.

maria_oncall: Quick note — Zenobu seeing increased 5xx from their dedicated pool only, other customers unaffected so far. Need tailored comms.

aj_eng: log snippet: ```
Oct 03 14:18:12 router-3 x: upstream 502 connection reset by peer id=zenobu-dedicated-42
Oct 03 14:18:13 router-3 x: kvcache miss spike, tail latency 2.1s
```

sam_sre: autoscaler shows 0 new pods for 3m, NLB health checks flapping for 10% of nodes. suspect intermittent node NIC/driver issue.

olga_pm: We need a concise status page update + a Zenobu-tailored notification for their account team. Draft please.

lee_cs: I'll prep the customer-facing note once we have impact scope. Who from Zenobu should we notify first?

maria_oncall: Zenobu contact routing: primary is account-lead@zenobu.com, ops@zenobu.com, and urgent-pager is +1-415-555-0142 (SLA escalation). Also CC enterprise-success.impact.

aj_eng: Action plan: 1) isolate affected nodes and drain 2) spin replacement instances (manual) 3) failover Zenobu traffic to shadow dedicated-eu-2 for degraded capacity 4) collect kernel logs and NIC metrics. Doing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: drain nodes (zenobu-dedicated-42) - job id dpl-87321.

maria_oncall: Draft status page update (internal review): "We are investigating elevated 502 errors affecting Zenobu on the Dedicated EU pool. Impact: some Zenobu API calls may return 5xx or experience increased latency. Mitigation: draining and replacing affected hosts; temporary traffic failover. ETA for restored service: 15-30 minutes. We will update in 15 minutes or sooner."

aj_eng: internal note for SRE runbook (short): "If dedicated pool NIC flapping suspected -> cordon node, capture dmesg + ethtool stats, replace instance; enable temporary routing to fallback pool and throttle burst traffic to reduce load."

lee_cs: Customer message draft for Zenobu: "Hi Zenobu team — we’re investigating an issue affecting your dedicated inference pool in EU. Some requests may return errors or be slower. Our engineers are draining problematic hosts and routing traffic to a fallback pool. We expect service to be restored within 30 minutes. We’ll follow up with a post-incident summary and any required remediation steps. — Maria, Redwood Oncall"

olga_pm: Add explicit ask: include contact for any in-progress launches or SLO concerns; offer a one-hour war room if they want deep dive.

maria_oncall: I've sent the short notice to account-lead@zenobu.com and ops@zenobu.com; marked high priority. (cc enterprise-success).

aj_eng: Replacements booting, NLB reconfiguration in progress. Observability shows error rate dropping ~40% after failover started.

sam_sre: Confirming NIC driver kernel oops on node-7. Captured logs and creating ticket for infra to patch.

maria_oncall: Updated status page text to include: "Partial mitigation in progress; error rate decreased after traffic reroute. Investigating root cause; next update in 15 minutes."

lee_cs: Zenobu replied: "Thanks — please escalate to bizops if ETA slips past 1 hour." forwarding to olga_pm and maria_oncall.

olga_pm: Noted. If we hit 1 hour, proposed exec note ready (short tailored blurb + SLA credit offer).

maria_oncall: Handoff at 15:00 UTC to night oncall @aj_eng. I'll stay in war room for handover notes. Final internal template for postmortem/customer: "Timeline, root cause, impact list (accounts, endpoints), mitigation steps taken, next steps (patch schedule, preventative controls), SLO credit calc."

aj_eng: I'll follow up in the handoff with logs and pinned runbook. Confirming last_message.

incident-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" at 2024-10-03T14:21:58Z (operator: maria_oncall).
